name: Turkish citizenship by investment: primary source index
description: Machine-readable index of the primary legal instruments, official statistical publications and official statements behind the datasets in this repository. Every figure published here is traceable to an entry in this file.

conventions.id: Stable identifier. Records in the datasets may reference these identifiers; the identifiers are not renamed once published.
conventions.resmiGazete: Publication in the Turkish Official Gazette: date in ISO 8601 and issue number (sayi). Null where the instrument is not published in the Official Gazette, for example an internal circular of a general directorate.
conventions.titleTr: Official Turkish title, with Turkish characters.
conventions.titleEn: English rendering for readers. Not an official translation unless marked.
conventions.url: Stable public URL where one was located, otherwise null.
conventions.verification: official_text_located = a URL to the official or officially consolidated text was located and the citation matches its header. official_reference_located = the citation matches an official reference such as the Official Gazette archive or the mevzuat.gov.tr index, but the operative wording was not re-read for this release. secondary = the citation rests on secondary reporting and is flagged for confirmation against the primary text.
conventions.lastChecked: Date this entry's citation details were last checked by a maintainer.

sources.titleEn: Turkish Citizenship Law

articlesUsed.subject: Acquisition of Turkish citizenship by exceptional means. Sub-paragraph (b) names persons holding a residence permit under Law No. 6458 Art. 31(1)(j) and Turquoise Card holders, with their foreign spouse and the minor or dependent foreign children of the person and of the spouse ("kendisinin ve eşinin ergin olmayan veya bağımlı yabancı çocuğu").
Annulment (iptal) of a decision granting citizenship where it followed a false declaration or the concealment of material facts
Liquidation of assets following loss of citizenship
Withdrawal (geri alinma) of a citizenship decision later found to have been issued without the legal conditions being met, or issued twice

sources.titleTr: Turk Vatandasligi Kanununun Uygulanmasina Iliskin Yonetmelik
sources.titleTrNative: Türk Vatandaşlığı Kanununun Uygulanmasına İlişkin Yönetmelik
sources.titleEn: Regulation on the Implementation of the Turkish Citizenship Law

articlesUsed.subject: Procedure and criteria for exceptional acquisition of Turkish citizenship, including the qualifying investment amounts and holding periods

As amended by Presidential Decision No. 5554 (RG 13 May 2022): "İkinci fıkranın (b), (ç), (d), (e) ve (f) bentlerinde belirtilen döviz tutarları işlem öncesinde Türkiye'de faaliyet gösteren bir bankaya ve bu bankaca da Merkez Bankasına satılır." The foreign currency for real estate (b), bank deposit (ç), government debt instruments (d), investment fund shares (e) and private pension (f) is sold to a bank operating in Turkiye and by that bank to the Central Bank before the transaction. The lira proceeds are held for three years in a lira deposit (ç), in lira-denominated government debt instruments (d) and in the SEDDK-determined pension funds (f). Fixed capital investment (a) and job creation (c) are not named.

sources.note: Article 20 has been amended repeatedly. The amendments that moved the thresholds are indexed separately below. Always read the consolidated text rather than the 2010 original. The consolidated text's header gives the Council of Ministers decision as 11 February 2010, No. 2010/139, published in the Resmi Gazete of 6 April 2010, No. 27544.

sources.titleEn: Amendment introducing the investor route into the implementing Regulation
sources.effect: Introduced the investor route. Real estate threshold USD 1,000,000; bank deposit threshold USD 3,000,000.

sources.titleEn: Amendment to the investor route criteria
Presidential Decision No. 106
sources.effect: Cut the thresholds: real estate to USD 250,000, bank deposit, government bonds and investment fund shares to USD 500,000, fixed capital investment to USD 500,000, job creation to 50 employees.
sources.note: A Presidential Decision (Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı), not a Presidential Decree (Cumhurbaşkanlığı Kararnamesi). The footnotes of the consolidated Regulation on mevzuat.gov.tr cite it as "19/9/2018 tarihli ve 30540 sayılı Resmi Gazete'de yayımlanan 106 sayılı Cumhurbaşkanı Kararı". Earlier releases of this dataset labelled it a decree.

sources.titleEn: Presidential Decision No. 5554
sources.effect: Raised the real estate threshold from USD 250,000 to USD 400,000, in force one month after publication. The same amendment added the private pension route at USD 500,000 as Article 20(2)(f), in force on the date of publication, while the real estate rise took effect one month later. Article 2 of the Decision also rewrote Article 20(10), which since then names sub-paragraphs (b), (ç), (d), (e) and (f).

sources.titleEn: Fees Law

articlesUsed.subject: Title deed and cadastre fees. Tariff No. 4 applies the transfer fee at 20 per thousand to the transferor and 20 per thousand to the transferee separately, which is the 4 per cent figure in data/government-costs.csv. The rate was set at 20 per thousand by Bakanlar Kurulu Karari 2012/3735 of 2012-09-20, replacing 16.5 per thousand.
Fee base in transfers of immovable property: the declared transfer value, which may not be below the property tax value

sources.titleTr: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Mudurlugu 2024/4 sayili Genelge
sources.titleEn: General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre Circular No. 2024/4
sources.subject: Procedure for the Tutar Tespit Belgesi (TTB, amount determination document) that confirms the qualifying real estate amount for a citizenship file, and the valuation report it rests on.

provisions: Valuation report not required on other transactions to which foreigners are party: "yabancıların taraf olduğu vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlemler dışındaki diğer işlemlerde taşınmaz değerleme raporu aranılmayacak".

Six-month maximum gap between the TTB and the land registry application for the transaction that leads to citizenship (the title deed transfer), not the citizenship application: "TTB ile vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlem başvuru süresi arasındaki fark altı ayı geçmeyecektir. Altı ayı geçen TTB'lerde belgeye esas değerleme raporu yenilenecektir."
The declared sale price, or the total in a promise to sell, and the total of the transfers or payments must each reach USD 400,000 ("ayrı ayrı"), confirmed by the TTB.
Transactions by public bodies and their undertakings, and by real estate investment trusts (gayrimenkul yatırım ortaklıkları), need no TTB, though the General Directorate may ask for one.
Repealed Circulars 2019/1 (1795) of 2019-02-15 and 2019/5 (1799) of 2019-05-30, and the instructions of 2021-12-07 and 2024-03-05.
versionRead.readFrom: TKGM PDF https://www.tkgm.gov.tr/sites/default/files/2024-12/2024-4%20Sayili%20Genelge_Degisik-1.pdf, read through the web.archive.org copy because the TKGM file host serves an HTML page instead of the PDF

amendedBy.effect: Introduced the TTB, the six-month window between the TTB and the land registry application for the transaction, the end of the valuation report requirement on transactions not involving citizenship acquisition, and the repeal of Circulars 2019/1 and 2019/5. TKGM announced it on 2024-12-11.

amendedBy.titleEn: Makam Oluru of 2026-09-28, no. 21914825, announced by TKGM on 2026-09-29 ("2024/4 Sayılı Genelge Değişikliği Hakkında Duyuru")
amendedBy.effect: Extends the window between the TTB and the land registry application for the transaction that leads to citizenship from six months to twelve, lets the valuation report behind the TTB be prepared by any SPK-authorised valuation firm, rewrites the paragraph on real estate investment trusts, and repeals the instruction of 2026-01-06 no. E-66840836-125.01.01-18933034. The text names no separate in-force date for these changes; its closing clause still reads "İşbu Genelge değişiklikleri ve eki Kılavuz ile birlikte 09/12/2024 tarihinde yürürlüğe girer", which dates the December 2024 changes.
amendedBy.restsOn: Ministry approval (Bakanlık Makamı Oluru) of 2026-09-18, no. 21900458
quotes: TTB ile vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlem başvuru süresi arasındaki fark oniki ayı geçmeyecektir. Oniki ayı geçen TTB'lerde belgeye esas değerleme raporu yenilenecektir. (İlgi (ı) Makam Oluru ile değişik ifade)

TTB, ilgi (ğ) sayılı Bakanlık Makam Oluru doğrultusunda Sermaye Piyasa Kurulu tarafından yetkilendirilmiş herhangi bir Değerleme Kuruluşu tarafından düzenlenen (İlgi (ı) Makam Oluru ile değişik ifade) taşınmaz değerleme raporundan elde edilen ... dokümandır

Ancak gayrimenkul yatırım ortaklıklarının yabancılara vatandaşlık kazanımı amacı ile yaptıkları taşınmaz satışı veya satış vaadi sözleşmesi işlemlerinde ... KAP'ta yayınlanan ve konu bağımsız bölümün değerini içeren değerleme raporlarını ibraz etmeleri veya WEBTAPU/TADEBİS üzerinden TTB'ye esas yeni bir değerleme raporu talebinde bulunmaları gerekmektedir. (İlgi (ı) Makam Oluru ile değişik ifade.)
amendedBy.readFrom: Consolidated text "2024-04 Sayili Genelge_Türk Vatandaşlığı Kanununun Uygulanmasına İlişkin Yönetmelik Hk." at https://www.tapumevzuati.com.tr/mevzuat.php?indir=MEVZUAT+BANKASI%2FGENELGELER%2FG%C3%9CNCEL+GENELGELER%2F2024-04+Sayili+Genelge_T%C3%BCrk+Vatanda%C5%9Fl%C4%B1%C4%9F%C4%B1+Kanununun+Uygulanmas%C4%B1n%C4%B1a+%C4%B0li%C5%9Fkin+Y%C3%B6netmelik+Hk..pdf (tapumevzuati.com.tr, a private mirror of TKGM circulars; PDF modified 2026-09-28), read on 2026-11-20. The TKGM announcement page links the file "2024-4 Sayili Genelge_Duzenlenen" at https://cms-api.tkgm.gov.tr/media/101815/view, which timed out from the server used, as did a Wayback Machine save request; no Wayback capture exists. The header matches the circular (E-36189470-125.01.01-12973768, 13.06.2024) and its ilgi list names the amending instruments.

sources.note: Circulars of the General Directorate are not published in the Official Gazette. The version in force from 2024-12-09 was read in full from the archived TKGM PDF. The amendment by Makam Oluru no. 21914825 of 2026-09-28, announced on 2026-09-29, was read on 2026-11-20 in the consolidated text reproduced by tapumevzuati.com.tr, because the TKGM file host could not be reached; it is marked secondary until read from TKGM. Earlier releases attributed a 2026 amendment of this circular to a Makam Oluru no. 21914825 and release 1.4.0 withdrew that attribution because no instrument with that number had been found. The consolidated text lists it as ilgi (ı), "28/09/2026 tarihli ve 21914825 sayılı Makam Oluru", so the attribution is restored: no. 21914825 amends Circular 2024/4, and no. E-90759875-020-22003020 of the same date updates Circular 2024/2.
provisions_current: Twelve-month maximum gap between the TTB and the land registry application for the transaction that leads to citizenship (the title deed transfer), not the citizenship application, since Makam Oluru no. 21914825 of 2026-09-28: "TTB ile vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlem başvuru süresi arasındaki fark oniki ayı geçmeyecektir." The "işlem başvuru" is the application for the title deed transaction; Ra Legal confirms from its own filings (2026-11-23) that land registry directorates measure the twelve months to the title deed transaction date.
The TTB rests on a report by any SPK-authorised valuation firm, following the Ministry approval of 2026-09-18 no. 21900458.

Transactions by public bodies and by real estate investment trusts still need no TTB ("TTB ile teyit edilmesine gerek bulunmamaktadır"), but a trust selling to a foreigner for citizenship must produce a KAP-published report covering the unit or request a new report through WEBTAPU/TADEBİS; the review of the property investment determination certificate is then referred to the Foreign Affairs Department.

sources.note: The Ministry publishes these statements on icisleri.gov.tr under Basın Açıklamaları. The statements of 4 August and 21 September 2026 were read there on 2026-11-20 and every enforcement figure in data/statistics.json attributed to the Ministry matches them. The 4 August statement names the legal basis for the cumulative total jointly: Law No. 5901 arts. 31 (annulment, iptal) and 40 (withdrawal, geri alma); it calls the 5,391 annulled (iptal) and the 743 withdrawn (geri alınmıştır) on the ground that the legal conditions were not met. The ministerial statement of 29 May 2026 has not been located on the Ministry site.

statements.title: Sahte Değerleme/Ekspertiz Operasyonu ve Usulsüz Vatandaşlık İşlemleri Hakkında Basın Açıklaması
quotes: muvazaalı veya usulsüz işlem gerçekleştirdiği tespit edilen 1.150 yatırımcının yatırım uygunluk belgesi iptal edilmiş ve aile fertleri dâhil toplam 5.391 kişinin vatandaşlık kararı iptal edilmiştir.

haklarında kamu düzeni ve millî güvenlik bakımından sakıncalı olduğu tespit edilen 263 yatırımcı ve aile fertleriyle birlikte toplam 743 kişinin vatandaşlık kararı hukuki şartların oluşmadığı gerekçesiyle geri alınmıştır.
Böylelikle toplamda 1.413 yatırımcı ve aile fertleri ile birlikte 6.134 kişinin vatandaşlık kazanma kararı 5901 sayılı Kanunun 31. ve 40. maddeleri uyarınca iptal edilmiş ya da geri alınmıştır.

11.02.2026 tarihinden itibaren ise yatırım uygunluk belgesi iptal edilen 443 yatırımcı ile aile fertleri olmak üzere toplamda 1.358 kişinin Türk vatandaşlığı iptal edilmiş, 7 kişinin ise haklarında milli güvenlik ve kamu düzeni bakımından sakınca bildirilmesi nedeniyle vatandaşlığı geri alınmıştır.
16 ilde sahte gayrimenkul değerleme raporlarıyla usulsüz vatandaşlık sağlayan şebekeye yönelik gerçekleştirilen operasyonda 72 şüphelinin yakalanması

263 yatırımcı ve aile fertleriyle birlikte toplam 743 kişinin vatandaşlık kararı geri alınmıştır.

11 Şubat 2026 tarihinden itibaren ise yatırım uygunluk belgesi iptal edilen 458 yatırımcı ve aile fertleri olmak üzere toplam 1.393 kişinin vatandaşlığı iptal edilmiş, 7 kişinin vatandaşlığı ise millî güvenlik ve kamu düzeni bakımından sakınca bulunması nedeniyle geri alınmıştır.

aile bireyleriyle birlikte 1.070 kişi ile vatandaşlık edinme süreci devam eden 11 kişi tespit edilmiştir. Yapılan incelemede bu kişilerin 263'ünün yatırımcı, 807'sinin aile ferdi olduğu; 1.015 kişinin karar tarihinde, 55 çocuğun ise karar tarihinden sonra Türk vatandaşlığını kazandığı anlaşılmıştır.
Vatandaşlık süreci devam eden 11 kişiden 1'i hakkında geri alma, 3'ü hakkında ret işlemi gerçekleştirilmiş, 7 kişinin ise vatandaşlık başvurusunda bulunmadığı tespit edilmiştir.

openQuestions: Decision numbers (esas and karar) for the Danistay rulings in the litigation series are not yet recorded.

The amended texts of TKGM Circular 2024/2 (Makam Oluru no. E-90759875-020-22003020 of 2026-09-28) and Circular 2024/4 (Makam Oluru no. 21914825 of 2026-09-28) have been read only in third-party copies (memurlar.net, tapumevzuati.com.tr), because the TKGM file host cms-api.tkgm.gov.tr could not be reached and no Wayback capture exists. Re-read both from TKGM when its file host serves them, and record any in-force date TKGM states for the September 2026 changes; the 2024/4 text itself names none.

The legal instrument behind the USD 200,000 property threshold for residence permits announced on 2023-10-16 has not been identified. Since 30 November 2024 Law No. 6458 art. 31(6) (added by Law No. 7533) lets the Ministry of Interior set the value, but no published determination under it was found. The only official text located that states the figure is the e-ikamet document checklist for short-term permits (Wayback capture of 5 May 2025): "The value of the house must be at least 200 thousand US Dollars equivalent to Turkish Lira as of the date of acquisition". The goc.gov.tr announcement and press lists contain no announcement of it, and e-ikamet.goc.gov.tr itself could not be reached from the server used on 2026-11-20.

The series in data/investment-returns.json have no entries in this register. Borsa Istanbul index levels, TCMB deposit rates and the TCMB residential property price index each need a dated entry with a URL and a retrieval date before a figure from that file can be cited the way a legal figure can.
The lira gram gold price series in data/investment-returns.json has no identified publication at all.

The forum, the time limit and the availability of a stay of execution for a challenge to a decision annulling (Law No. 5901 art. 31) or withdrawing (art. 40) a grant of citizenship. Law No. 2577 is now in the register but the applicable provisions have not been read against these decisions, so the annulment page states the gap rather than an answer.

closedQuestions.question: Sources disagree on the validity period of the appraisal report underlying the Tutar Tespit Belgesi. The 2026-09-28 amendment to circular 2024/4 is reported to set the window between the Tutar Tespit Belgesi and the application for the title deed transaction at 12 months, which may be the origin of the disagreement, but the circular text has not been read.
closedQuestions.answer: The validity of the valuation report is set by TKGM Circular 2024/2, not by the Citizenship Regulation: 3 months from 4 March 2024 ("kullanım süresi 3 aydır"), and 12 months since the circular was updated by Makam Oluru of 28 September 2026, no. E-90759875-020-22003020 ("kullanım süresi 12 aydır"), resting on the Ministry approval of 18 September 2026, no. 21900458. The update also lets any SPK-licensed valuation firm in TADEBIS prepare the report, chosen by the applicant. The six-month window between the Tutar Tespit Belgesi and the land registry application for the transaction (not the citizenship application) is a different period, set by Circular 2024/4 as in force from 9 December 2024 ("altı ayı geçmeyecektir"); its extension to twelve months in September 2026 is confirmed in practice by Ra Legal, which publishes this dataset; the amending text has not been read and stays open above.

closedQuestions.question: Which sub-paragraphs of Regulation Art. 20(2) the Art. 20(10) lira-conversion requirement reaches. Ra Legal's deposit guide states (b), (c-cedilla), (d) and (e); only the bank deposit is recorded as settled in investment-thresholds.json. Counsel to confirm.
closedQuestions.answer: Regulation Art. 20(10), as amended by Presidential Decision No. 5554 of 13 May 2022, names sub-paragraphs (b), (ç), (d), (e) and (f): "İkinci fıkranın (b), (ç), (d), (e) ve (f) bentlerinde belirtilen döviz tutarları işlem öncesinde Türkiye'de faaliyet gösteren bir bankaya ve bu bankaca da Merkez Bankasına satılır." It reaches real estate, the bank deposit, government debt instruments, investment fund shares and the private pension. It does not name fixed capital investment (a) or job creation (c). investment-thresholds.json records this per route.

closedQuestions.question: The TKGM circulars previously unread: Circular 2021/6, and the text of the amendment to Circular 2024/4 announced on 2026-09-29, reported to extend the six-month window between the Tutar Tespit Belgesi and the application for the title deed transaction to twelve months.
closedQuestions.answer: Circular 2024/4 was amended by Makam Oluru no. 21914825 of 28 September 2026 (ilgi (ı) of the consolidated text): "TTB ile vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlem başvuru süresi arasındaki fark oniki ayı geçmeyecektir. Oniki ayı geçen TTB'lerde belgeye esas değerleme raporu yenilenecektir." The twelve-month window is confirmed by the text. It runs to the land registry application for the transaction that leads to citizenship ("vatandaşlık kazanımı içeren işlem başvuru"), not to the citizenship application, which Ra Legal confirms is how directorates apply it. The same amendment lets any SPK-authorised valuation firm prepare the report behind the TTB and rewrites the paragraph on real estate investment trusts. The text names no separate in-force date. It was read in a third-party copy (tapumevzuati.com.tr), see tkgm-genelge-2024-4. Circular 2021/6 (1911) of 15 September 2021, in force 20 September 2021, was read in the archived TKGM PDF; it set the TADEBIS and Web Tapu procedure for valuation reports and is now repealed.

closedQuestions.question: Four instruments are relied on in prose without register entries, because their Resmi Gazete date and issue could not be confirmed against an official text: Law No. 2575 (Danistay Kanunu), Law No. 6735 (Uluslararasi Isgucu Kanunu, needed to say properly that a residence permit is not a work permit), Law No. 1512 (Noterlik Kanunu, which carries the sworn translation and notarial step), and Law No. 5237 (Turk Ceza Kanunu, referenced only to separate administrative measures from criminal liability).
closedQuestions.answer: Read from the headers of the consolidated texts on mevzuat.gov.tr: Law No. 2575, Resmî Gazete 20/1/1982 No. 17580; Law No. 6735, 13/8/2016 No. 29800; Law No. 1512, 5/2/1972 No. 14090; Law No. 5237, 12/10/2004 No. 25611. Each now has a register entry.

closedQuestions.question: The HCCH competent-authority listing, which is a different table from the status table indexed as hcch-1961. Without it the legalisation page cannot name the authorities that issue an apostille in Turkiye.
closedQuestions.answer: HCCH lists for Türkiye: administrative documents, in provinces the Governor, the Head Official of the District or the Chief Secretary, in towns the Head Official of the District; judicial documents, the Presidencies of the Judicial Commissions where high criminal courts sit. Recorded under hcch-1961.

closedQuestions.question: Law No. 6458 sits at official_reference_located rather than official_text_located. Re-reading arts. 31(1) and 31(2) in the consolidated text would close two open paragraphs on the residence permit page at once, including the duration of a grant on the investor ground.
closedQuestions.answer: The consolidated text was read on 2026-11-20. Art. 31(2): up to two years at a time except under (j) and (k); art. 31(5): up to five years at a time under (j) and (k); art. 31(6), added by Law No. 7533 (Resmî Gazete 30 November 2024 No. 32738): the Ministry sets the type and value of the property for the property-owner permit; art. 28(2): student permit time counts at half.
